reading.body:
E-Foam sits at 550 Susan B. Britt Court in Winter Garden, Florida, but its classification as a data center campus rests on a name in OpenStreetMap alone. The facility name suggests a foam or insulation manufacturer. No operator specifications have been published, no power capacity is listed, and no independent verification of data center use exists.

Florida has 13 mapped facilities in this database, of which only 4 publish power capacity figures totaling 9.35 MW. This campus ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state, which means it publishes no capacity at all, a ranking artifact of missing data rather than scale.

Without published specifications, certifications, power supply figures, or operator claims, this entry cannot be read as evidence that E-Foam contributes to AI infrastructure. The research status is marked exhausted, indicating no further verification is available through public channels.
